correctness.rationale: Exact Stirling surjection count yields Z. Equality identifications yield two-site moments; full colour permutation symmetry makes distinct nonzero Fourier frequencies orthogonal, leaving (\(q-1\)) explicit (r+s)-by-(r+s) blocks. Contrast decomposition and a 2-by-2 characteristic polynomial reconstruct all eigenvalues; separation of one-site functions on \(q-1\) permissible colours proves positivity for \(q\ge3\). Exact fixed-r asymptotics follow from first two Stirling terms and 2-by-2 determinant. The packaged verify.py passed 27 finite enumerations and 324 eigenvalue checks; this does not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The globally constrained ensemble is a natural zero-temperature antiferromagnetic Potts sampling set. The theorem gives an exact complete frame-spectrum classification for every finite parameter, including sharp injectivity and all condition numbers. Its positive-dimensional contrast subspace collapses exponentially when the thin side has at least two vertices, while the star case has only quadratic squared ill-conditioning; that threshold is a mathematically informative distinction, not a mere recounting of colorings.
